name: Spinny Auction Negotiation v3.2
_versions_note: null = all versions returned by the agent in the window. For v3.2 only, list the version names or IDs (see callkaro-cli). Handoff quirk: switch_agent_language overwrites versionId to the final version, so version filtering uses the final version.
_success_note: post_call.price_agreed == true is the bot deal flag; Spinny Raw_Auctions sheet (crm_file) is ground truth for PA/token/stock-in. Never use conversion_status.

checks.label: Deals on EXPIRED-price leads (S4/S5) — should be 0
Calls where car was already sold (car_sold)

connected.hangup_in_greeting: Customer hung up or went silent during the greeting / name check, before the price.
connected.busy_callback: Customer is busy, driving, or asks to be called later.
connected.wrong_person: Wrong number, not the owner, or the owner is not available.
connected.refuses_ai: Customer refuses to talk to an AI / bot or asks for a real person.
connected.bot_stalled: Conversation was going, but the bot never reached the price.

pitched.long_opening_hangup: Customer hung up or went silent during or right after the long price turn, before answering.
pitched.customer_refused: Customer clearly says no with no counter figure.
pitched.wants_time: Customer wants time to think / talk to family / will call back.
pitched.bot_false_yes: Bot treated something that was not a clear yes as agreement and moved to closing.
pitched.bot_skipped_negotiation: Customer objected or gave a figure but the bot moved on without handling it.

negotiation.gap_too_big_firm: Customer gave an expectation far above the offer and stayed firm.
negotiation.hangup_during_rebuttal: Customer hung up while the bot was giving reasons.
negotiation.competitor_offer: Customer cites a higher offer from a dealer or competitor.
negotiation.bot_error: Bot made a clear mistake (wrong price, wrong language, repeated lines, talked over the customer).

escalation.gap_still_too_big: Revised price still far below what the customer wants; customer firm.
escalation.ocb_declined: Bot offered OCB / listing and customer declined.
escalation.bot_error: Bot escalated on an expired price, wrong figure, or looped.

defaults_used: stage rules copied from RCA scripts
